title: Who owns American mutual fund shares, by kind of owner

rows.name: Households and nonprofit organizations
rows.basis: what is left over after every measured owner

rows.name: State and local government employee pension funds

source: Federal Reserve Board, Financial Accounts of the United States (Z.1), table F522_1_s (amounts outstanding) and F522_1_t_tu (transactions, not seasonally adjusted), one line per holding sector
note: The share of each owner is of everything outstanding. Net bought is the Federal Reserve's quarterly net purchases; price and other changes is the change in holdings minus what was bought, which is mostly price moves. The Fed carries Treasury, agency, municipal and corporate bond totals at face value and most holders at market value, which is part of its published gap.
